# SmithChart

Smith chart of reflection coefficients (SPEC-003).

![SmithChart, light theme](../img/widgets/smith-chart-light.png#only-light){ width="228" }
![SmithChart, dark theme](../img/widgets/smith-chart-dark.png#only-dark){ width="228" }

**Graphs, specialized** · [Widget catalog](../widgets.md) · [API reference](../api.md#anywidget_instruments.SmithChart) ·
schema [`smith.schema.json`](../trait-contract.md)

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
k = np.arange(12) / 3
gamma = 0.6 * np.exp(1j * k)  # reflection coefficients
re, im = gamma.real.tolist(), gamma.imag.tolist()
ai.SmithChart(
    value=[{"name": "sweep", "style": "both", "re": re, "im": im}],
    label="SmithChart",
    size=(220, 220),
)
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | array of object | `[]` | host | Data sets {name, color, style, re, im} of reflection coefficients Γ = (Z - z0) / (Z + z0); a host plotting impedances converts them (Python: plot(z, kind="impedance")). |
| `z0` | number | `50` | host | Reference impedance in ohms, used to show impedances in the tooltips (must be > 0). |
| `show_admittance` | boolean | `false` | host | Also draw the constant-conductance circles. |
